messages:
gwen: Heads-up — over the last hour we're seeing a spike of function invocations routed to the fallback model because the fn-invoke validator marks the structured result as invalid, but the console only shows a generic "tool error" and the quota dashboard counts it as a success. Anyone else seeing this?
max: yep saw a blip. logs show `validator.reject` rates up ~4x for service/fnhook-prod, but no reject reason in the UI.
sarah: is this the new strict schema gate we turned on in canary? I rolled out a change last night but thought it was limited to 10%.
aj: it is canaried, but the sampling flag may not be respected for routed traffic. Sending a link to the trace for one request: https://traces.internal/trace/0e7f4
gwen: attaching an example payload that was rejected (redacted):
```
{
  "name": "generate_summary",
  "result": {
    "summary": "...",
    "confidence": "0.97"   // expect number but got string
  },
  "meta": { "request_id": "abc123" }
}
```
max: ah `confidence` should be a number per our contract. Validator currently uses strict JSON schema and emits `invalid_type` in logs.
sarah: so two UX problems: 1) console dashboard shows a single "tool errors" bucket and doesn't surface validation error type, 2) quota/usage metrics increment for these requests even though they were rejected and fell back — that skews unit-economics.
aj: current telemetry keys: `invoke.requests`, `invoke.success`, `invoke.fallback`, `validator.rejects`. But dashboards only bubble `invoke.fallback`. We need `validator.rejects_by_reason` or at least `validator.invalid_type` metric.
lena: +1. Also we should not count rejects that immediately triggered free fallback as a billable success. Billing signals should be tied to `final_model` or `final_route` rather than initial invoke.
ops-bot: deploy-notice: canary v3.2 strict-validator enabled on fnhook-prod 10% 02:10 UTC
gwen: proposal:
- add `validator.reject_reason` tag/dim to telemetry (string -> sampled histogram) so dashboards can group
- emit `invoke.billing_event` set to `fallback` or `success` after routing decision
- UI: expand the "tool errors" row to show a small breakdown (schema / timeout / adapter-429)
- add a quick link from validator metric to a sample set (random 1% of rejects) that includes payload + diff
max: implementation notes: the runtime already logs `validator.ctx.reason`. We can patch the telemetry pipeline to upsert that as `validator.reject_reason` with 1% sampling to avoid high cardinality.
sarah: on the UX side, can we add a tooltip: "Validation rejects do not imply customer-visible failures — click to see whether fallback occurred". Also add an option to filter dashboard by `strict_canary=true`.
aj: short-term mitigation: revert strict schema check for routes that have no explicit adapter contract until we ship better telemetry. Long-term: keep strict, but make it visible.
lena: who owns the console change? product/console or eng-platform?
gwen: let's split: eng-platform owns telemetry + billing event, console owns dashboard row and tooltip. I'll take ownership for telemetry. @max can you file the console ticket with the mockup?
max: filing now: https://issues.internal/PLAT-10432 - mock included
sarah: I'll add an `integration-test` that asserts validator rejects increment metric and that `invoke.billing_event` equals `fallback` for a fallback case.
aj: timeline: telemetry patch -> canary in 24h -> console change in 3 days -> rollback plan ready.
gwen: ok, action items:
- gwen: implement telemetry tag + billing event (ETA 24h)
- max: console ticket + mock (ETA 48h)
- sarah: tests + canary verification (ETA 24h)
- aj: monitor and be ready to roll back strict gate (oncall)
- ops-bot: annotate canary for visibility
gwen: thanks team. If you spot weird billing spikes, ping me immediately.
deploy-bot: rollout annotation: telemetry/validator-reason-metric scheduled for canary 10% at 03:00 UTC
max: one more thought — we should add a correlation id to the dashboard rows so support can link straight into traces.
lena: +1, otherwise support ends up asking for request ids and customers don't have them.
gwen: noted. will include correlation id in telemetry payload (sampled). closing thread for now, will post updates here.
